item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:20 HKT 10/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting southern China will be replaced by an easterly airstream today and tomorrow. The weather will improve and temperatures will rise slightly over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong early next week, and temperatures will fall again with a few rain patches over the region.

R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
